fields.title: Four selected removals do not bound all damage cases
fields.finding: All 56 reported frame comparisons reproduce with radial loads based on planar triangle areas. Across six f4 and nine f5 edge classes the stress ratio spans 1.959485–3.270739 and peak tension 0–1019.372 MPa. A static rigid-joint calculation does not prove a dynamic cascade after every possible member loss.
fields.proposed_fix: Pin mesh, pressure quadrature, joint model and removed edges; distinguish selected cases from an envelope. Keep nonlinear and installed-joint verification open.
